options.css: .pbi-board { --panel: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.045); --border: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.10); --text: #f4f7fb; --muted: #9aa4b2; --green: #22c55e; --yellow: #facc15; --red: #ef4444; --blue: #38bdf8; width: 100%; height: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; padding: 14px; font-family: "Inter", sans-serif; color: var(--text); background: radial-gradient(circle at top left, rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.12), transparent 32%), radial-gradient(circle at bottom right, rgba(167, 139, 250, 0.08), transparent 30%), linear-gradient(135deg, #11161d 0%, #0c1016 100%); border-radius: 14px; overflow: visible; } .pbi-root { width: 100%; height: 100%; min-height: 0; display: grid; grid-template-rows: auto 1fr; gap: 10px; overflow: visible; } .pbi-header { position: relative; z-index: 100; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; padding-bottom: 9px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); } .pbi-title { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; min-width: 0; } .pbi-title-icon { width: 34px; height: 34px; border-radius: 10px; display: grid; place-items: center; color: var(--blue); background: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.12); border: 1px solid rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.25); } .pbi-title-text strong { display: block; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 900; color: #ffffff; } .pbi-title-text span { display: block; margin-top: 1px; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 800; color: var(--muted); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.04em; } .pbi-actions { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; } .pbi-refresh { flex-shrink: 0; font-family: "Roboto Mono", monospace; font-size: 11px; color: var(--muted); padding: 7px 10px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--panel); border: 1px solid var(--border); } .pbi-insight-btn, .pbi-metric-btn { width: 34px; height: 34px; border-radius: 10px; cursor: pointer; display: grid; place-items: center; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.055); border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12); color: var(--muted); transition: all 0.2s ease; flex-shrink: 0; } .pbi-insight-btn { color: var(--yellow); background: rgba(250, 204, 21, 0.10); border-color: rgba(250, 204, 21, 0.28); } .pbi-insight-btn:hover, .pbi-metric-btn:hover { color: #ffffff; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.10); } .pbi-insight-popover, .pbi-metric-popover { position: absolute; z-index: 9999; display: none; padding: 12px; border-radius: 12px; background: rgba(17, 22, 29, 0.98); border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.14); box-shadow: 0 18px 46px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.58); backdrop-filter: blur(14px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(14px); } .pbi-insight-popover.open, .pbi-metric-popover.open { display: block; } .pbi-insight-popover { top: 44px; right: 0; max-width: calc(100vw - 32px); width: min(360px, 90vw); max-height: 240px; overflow-y: auto; border-color: rgba(250, 204, 21, 0.22); } .pbi-insight-popover strong, .pbi-metric-popover strong { display: block; font-size: 12px; color: #ffffff; margin-bottom: 5px; } .pbi-insight-popover span { display: block; color: var(--muted); font-size: 11px; line-height: 1.45; word-break: break-word; overflow-wrap: anywhere; } .pbi-gauge-grid { position: relative; z-index: 80; display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 10px; overflow: visible; } .pbi-gauge-card { position: relative; z-index: 1; min-width: 0; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 92px 1fr auto; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 10px 12px; border-radius: 13px; background: var(--panel); border: 1px solid var(--border); backdrop-filter: blur(12px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(12px); overflow: visible; } .pbi-gauge-card:hover { z-index: 120; } .pbi-gauge { --value: 0; --color: var(--blue); width: 88px; height: 88px; border-radius: 50%; display: grid; place-items: center; background: radial-gradient(circle at center, #11161d 0 58%, transparent 59%), conic-gradient(var(--color) calc(var(--value) * 1%), rgba(255,255,255,0.10) 0); position: relative; } .pbi-gauge::after { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 9px; border-radius: 50%; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08); } .pbi-gauge-value { position: relative; z-index: 2; font-family: "Roboto Mono", monospace; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 900; color: #ffffff; } .pbi-gauge-info { min-width: 0; } .pbi-gauge-label { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 900; color: var(--muted); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.04em; } .pbi-gauge-title { margin-top: 5px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 800; color: #ffffff; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; } .pbi-gauge-status { width: fit-content; margin-top: 7px; padding: 4px 8px; border-radius: 999px; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 900; text-transform: uppercase; } .pbi-gauge-status.good { color: var(--green); background: rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.12); border: 1px solid rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.24); } .pbi-gauge-status.warn { color: var(--yellow); background: rgba(250, 204, 21, 0.12); border: 1px solid rgba(250, 204, 21, 0.24); } .pbi-gauge-status.bad { color: var(--red); background: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.12); border: 1px solid rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.24); } .pbi-gauge-status.ref { color: var(--blue); background: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.12); border: 1px solid rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.24); } .pbi-metric-popover { top: 104px; right: 10px; width: 225px; } .pbi-metric-list { display: grid; gap: 7px; } .pbi-metric-row { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 10px; padding: 7px 8px; border-radius: 8px; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04); border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.07); } .pbi-metric-row span { font-size: 10px; color: var(--muted); font-weight: 900; text-transform: uppercase; } .pbi-metric-row strong { margin: 0; font-family: "Roboto Mono", monospace; font-size: 11px; color: #ffffff; white-space: nowrap; } .pbi-empty { height: 100%; min-height: 150px; display: grid; place-items: center; text-align: center; color: var(--muted); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; border-radius: 12px; border: 1px dashed rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.18); background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.035); } .svg-icon { display: inline-grid; place-items: center; width: 1em; height: 1em; line-height: 1; vertical-align: -.125em; flex-shrink: 0; } .svg-icon svg { width: 1em; height: 1em; display: block; } .pbi-gauge-icon { font-size: 30px; color: #14B8A6; line-height: 1; } .pbi-net-rows { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; margin-top: 8px; } .pbi-net-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 5px 10px; border-radius: 999px; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04); border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08); } .pbi-net-row.down { background: rgba(52, 211, 153, 0.10); border-color: rgba(52, 211, 153, 0.25); } .pbi-net-row.up { background: rgba(251, 146, 60, 0.10); border-color: rgba(251, 146, 60, 0.25); } .pbi-net-dir { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 900; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.03em; color: var(--muted); flex-shrink: 0; } .pbi-net-dir svg { width: 11px; height: 11px; display: block; } .pbi-net-row.down .pbi-net-dir { color: #34d399; } .pbi-net-row.up .pbi-net-dir { color: #fb923c; } .pbi-net-val { margin-left: auto; font-family: "Roboto Mono", monospace; font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 900; color: #ffffff; } @media (max-width: 1100px) { .pbi-board { overflow: auto; } .pbi-root { height: auto; } .pbi-gauge-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } }

spec.description: Barra com o consumo de memoria (working set) de cada container, com rolagem. Quando o container tem limite (container_spec_memory_limit_bytes), a barra mostra % do limite e muda de cor (verde/amarelo/vermelho) conforme se aproxima dele; sem limite, mostra "S/L" e a barra fica relativa ao maior consumidor.
